summary: BifrOSt has a typed intent layer over the app control socket: declared intents with typed parameters, entity queries, IntentResult values with dialog text, and manifest-declared Spotlight shortcuts for parameterless intents. Apple's execution model (foreground/background modes, authentication policy, snippets, enum and common data types, donations, Focus filters, widgets and controls, schema domains) is not covered, and Siri and Apple Intelligence have no counterpart.

features.note: id, title and description are declared and listed by intent.list; no isDiscoverable flag

features.apple: IntentParameter, primitive and framework types (Integers, Doubles, Booleans, Strings, URLs, Dates, Files, Currencies, People, Placemarks, Measurements)
features.note: String, Int, Bool, Date (ISO 8601 text), Url and Entity(type) only; no Double, Files, Currencies, People, Placemarks or Measurements; parameters are validated by the SDK before perform
returns a JSON value and dialog text to the caller; the shell neither shows nor speaks the dialog
Wave 3 (w3-app-intents, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no interactive result view for an intent

Wave 2 (app-intents, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. an intent cannot hand off to another intent or open a screen in the app

Wave 2 (theme-07, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. intents always run in the app process; no foreground or background choice and no authentication policy

features.apple: AppEntity, EntityQuery (entities(for:), entities(matching:), suggestedEntities), defaultQuery, DisplayRepresentation
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs:208 (Entity), :238 (EntityQuery), entity.query over the control socket
features.note: suggested, by id and by string are served by App::entities; no defaultQuery, no URL representation, no ownership or sharing

Wave 5 (w5-app-intents, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. ParamType has no enum case; predefined value sets cannot be declared

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs:127 (shortcut flag), manifest [[intent]] tables read by springboard/src/shell/intents.rs
features.note: shortcut = true marks an intent as a Spotlight shortcut; no phrase list, tile colour or parameter-bearing shortcuts

features.apple: Spotlight integration, App Shortcuts in Spotlight and Shortcuts app
features.note: lists parameterless shortcuts without launching the app; choosing one launches the app and calls intent.<id> with up to 8 s retry; no parameter prompts or disambiguation
a Core Search indexing API exists, but it is not tied to App Intents entities; no IndexedEntity protocol
failures return RPC errors with a message; no typed error set and no needs-value or confirmation errors

features.apple: Common data types (Files, Dates, Currencies, Payments, People, Placemarks, Measurements)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-app-intents, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. only the parameter types listed under Intent parameters

Wave 2 (app-intents, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. apps cannot tell the system which intents were used; no relevance ranking

Wave 5 (w5-app-intents, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Focus is a notification switch; apps cannot declare filter intents
springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs is a drawing adapter for controls, not a widget extension point

features.apple: App schema domains, visual intelligence, Action button, side button
features.note: no system schema adoption; hardware-button and visual-search entry points are Apple-only

features.apple: Siri AI, Apple Intelligence integration, voice
features.note: Apple's assistant and voice stack; BifrOSt's dialog text is not spoken

gaps: Foreground and background execution modes, and authentication policy on AppIntent
App enums (AppEnum) for predefined parameter values
Parameter types for Double, Files, Currencies, People, Placemarks and Measurements
Snippets and result views, and follow-on intents (OpensAppIntent)
Parameter prompts and disambiguation in Spotlight (needsValueError, requestDisambiguation, requestConfirmation)
IndexedEntity: indexing App Intents entities in Spotlight, and hideInSpotlight
Focus filters (SetFocusFilterIntent); the shell only has Do Not Disturb
Widgets, controls and Live Activities driven by intents
Shortcuts app does not list or run intents yet (docs/bifrost-ui.md, App Intents gaps)
